title: Reducing Loneliness and Social Isolation of Older Adults Through Voice Assistants: Literature Review and Bibliometric Analysis
population: Older adults in studies of voice assistants for loneliness and social isolation
study_type: Systematic literature review and bibliometric analysis
intervention: Voice assistants to reduce loneliness and social isolation in older adults
evidence_strength_rationale: Heterogeneous review; most studies assessed usability or acceptability and only a minority directly assessed loneliness/social isolation.
limitations: Most included studies emphasized usability, acceptability, or user experience rather than loneliness/isolation outcomes directly
Voice assistant interventions and study designs were heterogeneous across included studies
implementation_implications: Separate usability/acceptability findings from loneliness or social isolation effectiveness evidence
Prioritize studies that directly measure social isolation or loneliness outcomes in pilot planning

title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI-based conversational agents for promoting mental health and well-being
population: Mixed populations across 35 experimental studies, including older adults in subgroup analyses
intervention: AI-based conversational agents for mental health and well-being
evidence_strength_rationale: Systematic review with 15 RCTs in the meta-analysis, but heterogeneous interventions and populations and limited older-adult-specific certainty.
limitations: Heterogeneous conversational agent designs and delivery platforms across included studies
Limited certainty for older-adult-specific applications despite subgroup findings
implementation_implications: Track depression symptoms and psychological distress separately from overall well-being
Account for heterogeneous agent designs and populations when interpreting pilot results

title: From loneliness to social connection: charting a path to healthier societies – Report of the WHO Commission on Social Connection
population: General populations affected by social isolation and loneliness
intervention: Policy and programmatic guidance on social connection
evidence_strength_rationale: Context source providing policy framing on social connection; not an effectiveness estimate.
implementation_implications: Frame pilot decisions within broader social connection policy context
Do not treat policy guidance as intervention effectiveness evidence

title: Reducing Patient Loneliness With Artificial Agents: Design Insights From Evolutionary Neuropsychiatry
intervention: Artificial agents informed by evolutionary neuropsychiatry design principles
evidence_strength_rationale: Design viewpoint source; not an effectiveness trial or synthesis.
limitations: Viewpoint article without empirical effectiveness outcomes
implementation_implications: Use design principles to inform agent interaction patterns, not as effectiveness proof
Plan for attachment and therapeutic relationship factors when designing agent pilots

title: Digital interventions to reduce social isolation and loneliness in older adults: An evidence and gap map
intervention: Digital interventions to reduce social isolation and loneliness in older adults
evidence_strength_rationale: Evidence-map source summarizing review and study distribution; not a pooled effectiveness estimate.
limitations: 72% of included systematic reviews were critically low quality
Evidence was geographically uneven, with sparse reporting of community-level outcomes
implementation_implications: Treat mapped evidence as directional because underlying review quality is often critically low
Address geographic and equity gaps before scaling pilots broadly

title: Remote Virtual Interactive Agents for Older Adults: Exploring Its Science via Network Analysis and Systematic Review
population: Older adults in studies of remote virtual interactive agents
intervention: Remote virtual interactive agents for older adults
evidence_strength_rationale: 13/15 studies reported broadly positive outcomes, but interventions, outcomes, and populations were heterogeneous and no pooled effectiveness estimate was reported.
limitations: Interventions, outcomes, and populations were heterogeneous across included studies
No pooled effectiveness estimate was reported
implementation_implications: Expect heterogeneity across virtual interactive agent interventions and measured outcomes
Do not assume pooled effectiveness from narrative synthesis alone
